facilities.heroTitle: Find the shortest ED wait near you.
facilities.heroSub: Live wait times for emergency departments and walk-in clinics from the live EDWT feed. Updated every few minutes.
facilities.sortWaitDesc: Prioritize sites reporting the lowest current wait.
facilities.sortDistDesc: Show the nearest open facilities first.
facilities.gpsNeedsHttps: GPS needs HTTPS on mobile devices
facilities.noFacilitiesOpen: No facilities are currently reporting as open.
facilities.noWaitTimes: No posted wait times are available right now.
facilities.feedPaused: The live feed may be paused or every site in range is closed.
facilities.noWaitData: Open facilities may still be accepting patients, but the live feed has not posted wait data.
facilities.shortestReportedWait: Shortest reported wait among open facilities — about a {wait} expected wait
facilities.withWaiting: with {count} people in the waiting room
facilities.emergencyBannerStrong: If this is a life-threatening emergency, call 9-1-1.
facilities.emergencyBannerBody: Chest pain, severe bleeding, stroke symptoms, or difficulty breathing need immediate care. For non-urgent health advice, dial <healthLink>8-1-1</healthLink> to reach a registered nurse 24/7.
facilities.nurseAdvice: Call <healthLink>8-1-1</healthLink> for nurse advice, or <emergencyLink>9-1-1</emergencyLink> if this is life-threatening.
facilities.expectOpen: The reported wait is the latest published wait-time reading for this facility. Sicker patients are seen first, so the live wait can change quickly.
facilities.expectWaiting: Right now there are {count} people in the waiting room.
facilities.expectNoWait: This facility is open, but no wait time is currently posted.
facilities.expectClosed: This facility is currently closed. It will reopen at the next scheduled time.
facilities.advice01Body: Call 8-1-1 to talk with a registered nurse 24/7. They can help you decide whether you need the ED, a clinic, or self-care at home.
facilities.advice02Body: Wait time is the duration for 9 out of 10 patients to be seen by a physician — not the full visit length. Sicker patients are seen first.
facilities.advice03Body: Bring your BC Services Card, a list of medications, and something to keep you occupied. Eat and drink lightly unless told otherwise.
facilities.footerTagline: Live emergency wait times · Lower Mainland, BC
facilities.footnote: Wait times are estimates only and update every few minutes. If your condition worsens while waiting, tell the triage nurse. This site is an independent demo and not affiliated with any health authority.

map.title: Facility Map
map.description: Interactive map of emergency departments and urgent care centres in the Lower Mainland, BC with live wait times and directions.
map.mapSidebarDesc: Wait-time markers are colored by severity. Pick a facility to inspect the current wait, distance, and directions.
map.topPressureNote: This site is currently in the top pressure group.
map.locationRequired: Precise location is required to show directions.
map.showLocationRequired: Precise location is required to show your location on the map.

analytics.heroSubtitle: A system-level view of current pressure, sustained risk, coverage quality, and care-type trends across tracked facilities.
analytics.readoutDesc: Fast scan of current wait-time pressure, sustained averages, and structural data gaps.
analytics.avgMedianWait: Average wait time {avg}, median wait time {median}
analytics.edVsUpccMedian: ED median wait time {ed} vs UPCC median wait time {upcc}
analytics.coverageDetail: Most are configured with wait-time display hidden, so treat this as product state rather than missing telemetry.
analytics.edVsUpccDesc: Median wait time and P90 wait time stay separate so tail pressure does not disappear inside an average.
analytics.currentWaitPressureDesc: Latest reading per facility, sorted by wait time.
analytics.aboveBaselineDesc: Current wait time versus each site's own short history.
analytics.noAboveBaseline: No above-baseline signals in the current data window.
analytics.sustainedHighDesc: Facilities with at least 50 readings, ranked by average wait time.
analytics.volatilityDesc: High standard deviation means the facility swings more than its peers.
analytics.locationsWithoutReadingsDesc: Useful for data quality checks and product-state audits.
analytics.everyLocationHasReadings: Every tracked location has at least one wait-time reading.
analytics.dbErrorTitle: The analytics page could not read Postgres.
analytics.dbErrorDesc: Check DATABASE_URL or the environment file used to start Next, then refresh this page.
analytics.shellTitle: Analytics page is loading without data.
analytics.shellDesc: The route rendered successfully without database queries. Data panels are temporarily disabled while production access is verified.
analytics.method1Title: Median wait time and P90 wait time first
analytics.method1Body: Average wait time is useful, but median wait time and P90 wait time are better for public pressure and tail-risk decisions.
analytics.method2Body: Each facility has its own normal range, so alerts compare current wait times to that site's own history.
analytics.method3Body: Locations with hidden wait-time display should be shown as product state, not confused with broken telemetry.

charts.currentAccessPressureDesc: Longest current wait times, severity-colored by threshold.
charts.edVsUpccTrendDesc: Median wait time and P90 wait time by care type, shown separately for clearer tail risk.
charts.sustainedFacilityPressureDesc: Facilities ranked by P90 wait time. Median wait time shows typical pressure; P90 wait time shows bad-day pressure.
charts.currentVsMedian: Current wait time vs usual median
charts.currentVsMedianDesc: Neutral dot is site median wait time; colored dot is current wait time. The line shows the gap.
charts.tailRiskMapDesc: Median wait time vs P90 wait time by facility. Upper-right sites are typically slow and painful in the tail.
charts.waitDistributionDesc: How many readings land in each wait-time bucket, useful for long-tail pressure checks.
charts.facilityHourPatternDesc: Top sustained-pressure facilities by local hour. Darker means higher average wait time.
charts.coverageVolumeDesc: Readings per facility. Low-volume facilities should be interpreted cautiously.
